lines.text: 生活里许多事无缘无故地发生。我们挑出几件，连成一条思路，就称之为理由。
lines.en: Random things happen for no reason in our lives. We choose a few and form a line of thought made by all these dots, which we call a reason.
lines.note: 成俊在 Novel 酒吧谈巧合时的对白；影评引述英文字幕通行译法（The Cinematograph 等）。
